name: Banh trang dap
summary: Bánh tráng đập, also called bánh tráng chập, is a Da Nang snack on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. You break the rice paper by hand. The same page also describes it as a crisp grilled cracker clapped to a warm steamed sheet, dipped in mắm nêm.
origin: Da Nang, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page, which calls the snack both spicy and salty. Bắc Mỹ An’s 2019 list names bánh đập. The same 2024 page later pairs bánh đập with hến xào and calls that combination a Hội An plate.
texture: The 16 Apr 2024 page says bánh chập is two things clapped together: mì lá and a crisp grilled rice cracker. Later on the page the steamed sheet is warm, chewy, and still soft, against the cracker.
taste: The page calls the snack spicy and salty. The dip in the later lines is mắm nêm from anchovy, with a little sugar, pineapple or lime, and red chili.
howToEat: Break the rice paper by hand into small pieces.
The later lines on the same page say to eat the crisp cracker with the warm steamed sheet and the mắm nêm.
where: The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a Da Nang street. Bắc Mỹ An’s 19 Jun 2019 roundup names bánh đập at 25 Nguyễn Bá Lân and prints 08:00–19:00. That clock is not restated later. Hến xào with bánh đập is filed with the Hội An plates.
